title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater (Late) on 1970-06-24
source: source: AUD Cassette Master taped by Jim Cooper; Hitachi mics > Hitachi trq-222 deck; Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark ADC1 24/96 > pc > adobe audition 2.0 > cd wave > flac; transfer & mastering by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Clear fan‑recorded audio of a legendary early‑1970 NYC run with standout Dark Star and The Other One, captured in surprisingly good quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (fan) tape that many reviewers describe as clearer and less muddy than other sources from this era, delivering a listenable lo‑fi experience. Musically the show shines – Dark Star and The Other One are repeatedly called fan‑dream moments, and the overall vibe of the summer 1970 setlist is praised as powerful and special.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight both strong performance (especially Dark Star/The Other One) and good‑enough audio quality, offset only by a few neutral/confusion posts.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fans note the tape is clearer than older muddy copies, with less echo; it’s not a soundboard but still delivers decent clarity for a lo‑fi source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its eclectic mix of acoustic and electric material, with the summer NYC run considered one of the band’s tightest and most inspiring performances.
